formulas.time_base: observed instants with a value inside the simulated record; simulated read straight between its samples
formulas.rsr: sqrt(sum((s - o)^2) / n) / sqrt(sum((o - mean(o))^2) / n) = sqrt(1 - NSE)
formulas.pbias_percent: 100 * sum(s - o) / sum(o); positive when the model is high (Moriasi 2007 uses the other sign)
formulas.rmse: sqrt(sum((s - o)^2) / n), in the quantity's unit
formulas.peaks: highest value of each series on its own samples between the first and last instant of the time base
formulas.volumes_m3: trapezoid of each series on its own samples in the same window, flow only; an observed gap bridged
